note: Nothing came across byte-for-byte. Unlike the earlier ports, whose captured model and loader were self-contained pretrain files, this method's captured code interleaves step 1 (AlexNet) and step 2 (ViT) in single files (train.py 1161 lines, utils.py 812 lines, models/context_encoder.py, datasets.py, evaluate_linear.py), so extracting a clean port required rewriting each. captured_sha256 is therefore empty; every file's captured digest is recorded below so a reviewer can diff against the capture. The unified ViT-B/16 Step 2 (arch: vit) is ported additively in NEW files (models/vit_context_encoder.py, train_pretrain_vit.py, configs/pretrain_vit.yaml), port-authored from the capture's ContextEncoderViT + train.py: the same centre-hole inpainting on a ViT-B/16 encoder + a transformer decoder, always adversarial (two AdamW optimisers), reusing the shared Discriminator. The capture's cluster-only STEP2 machinery (DDP, bfloat16, the 812-line utils.py resume contract) is not brought across; the ViT path adds timm (imported lazily on arch: vit) and the native AlexNet path is byte-for-byte unchanged.

rewritten_during_the_port.models/context_encoder.py: captured sha256 6448e67245936e2bd781f495d06893806ba49bec7804f1a06769b612010acabb. The native AlexNet path: the ContextEncoderAlexNet and Discriminator classes are the captured code unchanged; OfficialCaffeAlexNetFeatures, the file-top `timm` import and an unused `torchvision.models` import were removed, and create_model refuses 'official_alexnet' by name. create_model handles only 'alexnet' here; the ViT is a separate builder (models/vit_context_encoder.py), so this file stays timm-free.
rewritten_during_the_port.models/vit_context_encoder.py: new, port-authored from the capture's ContextEncoderViT. The centre-hole inpainting ViT: a timm VisionTransformer encoder under self.encoder (built directly, not via create_model('vit_base_patch16_224'), so the dimensions are configurable and a tiny CPU smoke can run; the shipped config is ViT-B/16) with the hole zeroed in forward_encoder, a 4-layer transformer decoder predicting the hole patches, and the shared Discriminator (reused, sized to the hole). encoder.pt is encoder.* alone; get_features(x) is the mean patch-token feature (embed_dim) of the unmasked image. timm is imported at file top, so it loads only on arch: vit.
rewritten_during_the_port.models/__init__.py: captured sha256 35ce7de1a77368cedf0f9e7a0fad1c45713f15fc11cb3150ef29074fb4734dc8. Re-exports create_model + build_vit_context_encoder; the ViT builder is a lazy accessor (needs timm), so the native AlexNet path never imports timm.
rewritten_during_the_port.datasets.py: captured sha256 8ec55f9afefd6596c17845568b4d31e8d37b4bdd535168060b96e032b7565eb8. Trimmed to InpaintingDataset + ImageNetLinearProbe + create_dataloader; dropped InpaintingDatasetViT (the ViT Step-2 port reuses the native InpaintingDataset, which returns the full image the ViT masks internally), CaffeAlexNetPreprocess (the official Caffe eval path, not brought across) and an unused numpy import.
rewritten_during_the_port.train_pretrain_vit.py: new, port-authored from the capture's train.py ViT path. Single-process, always-adversarial: two AdamW optimisers (generator + centre-hole discriminator), generator loss = (1-adversarial_weight)*MSE(pred_hole, target_hole) + adversarial_weight*BCE(D(pred_hole), 1), warmup+cosine to min_lr, AMP on CUDA, gradient clipping; milestone checkpoints. Reuses create_dataloader, resolve_device and make_deterministic. The capture's DDP/bfloat16/resume-contract machinery is dropped.
rewritten_during_the_port.train_pretrain.py: extracted from the captured train.py (sha256 f3b34680bb8635dc3d8ac434b0ebd46f409c15ba75e89a26a97a5f6848325d08). The AlexNet training path only, made single-process and full precision: resolve_device()/make_deterministic() added and the unconditional .cuda(args.gpu) replaced by .to(device); main() split into build_parser() and run(args, config), which returns the reconstruction/adversarial/total losses the captured version discarded. The captured DDP, AMP and step-2 machinery were not brought across. The small helpers (AverageMeter, adjust_learning_rate, compute_reconstruction_loss) are the captured utils.py code (sha256 cffab2a9cecea8e0ea65adbb53e3f00cbc643d0d0ee797a45ac2f58872ade806), inlined; the rest of utils.py was step-2 protocol machinery and was not brought across.
rewritten_during_the_port.evaluate_linear.py: captured sha256 b5d1ddcdea574388a054421cbd2297fc9df5834fa84797a2756619651382a66b. resolve_device()/make_deterministic() imported from the trainer; the unconditional torch.cuda.set_device / .cuda(args.gpu) replaced. main() split into build_parser() and run(args, encoder, in_dim), which returns its metrics; the captured version wrote results.json and returned nothing. run() accepts an encoder built by the caller (the contract's artifact is encoder.pt). extract_features and run are arch-aware: the AlexNet path reads the 4096-d bottleneck (model(x) -> (_, features)), the ViT path the mean patch-token feature (model.get_features(x), embed_dim). A bare model_type='vit' on the stand-alone CLI path (no encoder handed in) is still refused -- the ViT needs its config dimensions to rebuild. The step-2 protocol imports from utils (STEP2_PROTOCOL_VERSION, validate_step2_checkpoint, _nonfinite_tensor_paths) were dropped.
